context.T12: FD:L2644 (also reference/validation.md:130): Phase-A gate, '12 sites with X1-X7, د1-د5 and Q1-Q12, zero transactions without a click'. Sites, in order: (1) relative css, (2) folders, (3) classic scripts, (4) modules with importmap, (5) inline, (6) localStorage via BR17, (7) fetch JSON, (8) woff2, (9) images, (10) form, (11) SPA with internal links via BR18, (12) contract read and write, with BR14 as the legitimate path. Rate rejections are recorded per site; criterion: zero rate rejections at a normal load rate.
context.X8: FD:L2645 defines X8 (CanarySink on TCP 18080, 18443, 13478 and UDP 13478, 19000; channels C1-C8; flags K0-K2 zero access, K3 informational, K4 control, K5 zero for C5-C7). X1-X7 precede it in the same namespace.

mappingDecisions.proposal: Ordinal mapping: Q_i is the per-site acceptance check of T12 site i. Q8 woff2, Q9 images, Q10 form, Q11 SPA internal links, Q12 contract read and write.
mappingDecisions.basis: T12 lists exactly 12 sites and references Q1-Q12; the annex asks for Q8-Q12 only.
mappingDecisions.alternative: None found in reference/; Q1-Q5 in reference/validation.md:1458 are HeadCheck predicates (consensus) and unrelated to the extension annex.
mappingDecisions.gap: Q1-Q7 are referenced by T12 but are not required by FD:L4959 and are also undefined; they are outside this proposal's 17 items and recorded as an observation.

mappingDecisions.proposal: Isolation attempts, one per channel class not covered by X8, each measured with the X8 CanarySink and flags.
mappingDecisions.basis: Same namespace as X8; T12 runs them on every site.

mappingDecisions.proposal: The declared-unsupported features of FD:L1345 other than WebRTC (covered by X3 and X8): د1 eval, د2 relative import, د3 Workers, د4 cookies, د5 IndexedDB. Each must fail closed and observably.
mappingDecisions.basis: Five of the six unsupported features; the Arabic letter د is used in the extension annex, not the Latin 'd' of the disk tests.
mappingDecisions.rejectedAlternative: BR23 (d1)-(d5), the disk tests at FD:L3066ff. Not adopted: (a) BR23 is a unit test of DiskGate and FakeBackend, not a site-level check that T12 can run on 12 sites; (b) BR23 d1-d11 and d12-d15 are already required by annex rows E6 and E7 (FD:L5003, FD:L5007), so mapping would count them twice; (c) the notation differs (Latin d in parentheses vs Arabic د). The mapping is unestablished either way; the owner decides.

Pass for every item: CanarySink K0-K2 zero access; zero RpcTap requests caused by the probe (other than its own declared reads); zero eth_sendRawTransaction without a click; the frame keeps working (a later legitimate rpc_read eth_blockNumber succeeds).
